parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US: English

sub_parameters.name: DingtalkNotice
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable DingTalk notifications. Valid values:

- true: Enabled. When an alert is triggered, a DingTalk message is sent.

- false: Disabled.

sub_parameters.name: EmailNotice
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable email notifications. Valid values:

- true: Enabled. When an alert is triggered, an email is sent.

- false: Disabled.

sub_parameters.name: NoticeType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of alert event. Valid values:

- addr\_alert: The address is unavailable.

- addr\_resume: The address has recovered.

- addr\_pool\_unavailable: The address pool is unavailable.

- addr\_pool\_available: The address pool has recovered.

sub_parameters.name: SmsNotice
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable text message notifications. Valid values:

- true: Enabled. When an alert is triggered, a text message is sent.

- false: Disabled.

Note: Text message notifications are supported only on the China site (aliyun.com).

parameters.name: AlertGroup
parameters.description: A list of alert notification groups.

parameters.name: AlertMode
parameters.description:
The alert configuration mode for the instance. Valid values:

- global: The instance inherits the global alert configuration.

- instance\_config: The instance uses a custom alert configuration.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The client must generate a unique value for this parameter. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The ID of the domain name instance configuration. A GTM instance can have two configurations for the same access domain name if you configure both A and AAAA records. The ConfigId uniquely identifies a configuration.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance.
